eval.description: OpenAI internal agentic safe-completion evals on sensitive or unsafe tool-using scenarios. Categories cover Codex and Chat production-like traffic (including Chat Plugins) and human red-teaming sets. Scores the safety of actions taken, not only the final text, as safe completion rate. Dataset and runner are lab-internal.
eval.summary: Measures how often AI agents take safe actions, not only write safe text, in risky tool-using tasks.
